_comment: The six, SPEC.md §5. A trooper's role picks his base numbers out of data/rules.json; his `traits` are ids from data/traits.json that modify those numbers through the hook system. Nothing in code reads a trooper by name (CLAUDE.md rule 6). A seventh trooper is one more entry here plus one more start hex in data/map.json (until the drop replaces start hexes at M6).
_leader: `leader` marks the ranking man. It picks his counter frame and makes him the source of the command radius in data/rules.json. It is a flag, not a name, so promoting someone else is a one-line edit here.
_shortName: What fits on the counter's name strip. It is not required to be the surname: Holloway goes by his nickname.
_dialogue: Three lines every man must have, keyed onLand, onPlaceCharge, onWounded (SPEC.md §5), even a man who will never place a charge. The rest are optional, and a man without one is silent. onWoundedCarrying: said instead of onWounded when he is hit still carrying a charge, which then drops on his hex, so a line about the charge is only said when there is one to fetch; give it to the men who start with charges, and onWounded must then not mention one. onKill: after a gunner's kill or anyone's knife. onSpotted: the first time he is seen, not each turn he stays in view. onHide: going to ground. These are PLACEHOLDER lines, written to be replaced. Any line may be a list of lines (M54): one is said, fixed by the seed, the turn, the man and the moment, never rolled (units.js lineFor).

onLand: On me, lads. Quick and quiet.
onPlaceCharge: That's her set. Clear off, the lot of you.
Set and timed. Don't hang about.
onWounded: Only a scratch. Keep the lads moving.
I'm hit. Doesn't change the plan.
onWoundedCarrying: Charge is by my boots. Somebody fetch it and I'll catch up.
Dropped the charge. Someone pick it up, sharpish.
Charge is down. Don't leave it lying.
onKill: One less to worry about. Now keep your heads down.
Quiet as you like. Move on.
That's one. Eyes open for the rest.
onSpotted: They've seen us. Stick to the plan.
onHide: Get down and stay down. That's an order.

onLand: Not a scratch on me. Lucky old Fitch.
onWoundedCarrying: Oh, that's torn it. Charge is on the deck — mind how you lift it.
Ah, hell. Dropped the charge. Careful with it.
Hit! Charge is on the ground, somebody grab it.
onKill: Shouldn't have looked this way, mate.
onSpotted: Uh-oh... He's looking right at me.
onHide: Nice and snug here in the dirt.

onLand: This is a fine spot Sarge.
Good ground, this. Bridge is that way.
onPlaceCharge: Not my trade, this. Hope it goes bang.
Done, I think. Ask a sapper.
Set. Don't look at me if it fizzles.
onWounded: Should've kept my head down damn it. Go on, I'll catch up.
Caught one. Still got my eyes.
onKill: Didn't hear a thing, did he?
onSpotted: Spotted. I'll have to be quick about it.
They've seen me. Time to be elsewhere.

onLand: Missed every tree in France. Told you I would.
Not a branch touched me. Not one.
onPlaceCharge: Don't rush me, I'm reading the label.
If I lose a finger, I'm blaming Sarge.
onWounded: Leave it. Get to the bridge.
Don't wait for me. The bridge!
onKill: Hope nobody was fond of him.
He won't be missed. Not by me.
onHide: Down in the mud, where I belong.

onLand: Bren's in one piece. That's all that matters.
Bren and me, both down safe.
onPlaceCharge: Don't ask me to do that again.
Set. Don't tell anyone I did that.
onWounded: Bit of bother. Still got one good arm.
Hit. I can still pull a trigger.
onSpotted: Been made. Somebody sort this bloke out.
He's seen me. I've seen him too.
Spotted. Bren's ready if it comes to it.
onHide: Gun under me. Not a sound.

onLand: All the way down in one piece, Sarge.
onPlaceCharge: Heavy old thing. Glad to be done with it.
onWounded: Takes more than that to put me out of business.
onWoundedCarrying: Charge is down. Someone grab it.
Can't carry it now. Over to you.
onSpotted: Bit hard to hide a man my size.
Seen. Can't miss me, can they?
He's spotted me. Course he has.
onHide: Small as I can make myself. Which ain't small.
Hunched up. Not that it helps.
